fusions.name: Week-Old Catch
fusions.desc: Throws a spoiled fish that deals 26 damage to the first enemy within 7 tiles and leaves it [Diseased] for 8 seconds, then bursts over every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that damage.

fusions.name: Spatter School
fusions.desc: Flicks 4 darts of musk in a spread out to 6 tiles, each of which deals 2 damage with a 25% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. The poison passes on its own to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Oiled Scales
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: The Bite That Missed
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: a jet of musk strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
